newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks rebound in OTC trading.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks rebound in OTC trading.

text.p: Croatian stocks rebounded in over-the-counter trading on Varazdin Securities Market on Tuesday with hotel shares picking up after recent losses.
* Four of seven active issues rose, one fell, one was flat and one traded for the first time.
* 10-stock VIN index up 85 points or 0.96 percent to 8,961 points.
* Riviera hotel, the top gainer, rose 11.11 percent to 45 marks and was most actively traded with 304 shares sold.
* Loser, textile firm Varteks, shed 4.76 percent to 20 marks on volume of 269 units.
